keyPoints: Samantar chaturbhuj ka kshetrafal = aadhar x unnat (height); tribhuj ka kshetrafal = 1/2 x aadhar x unnat — unnat hamesha aadhar par lamb hoti hai.
Vritt ki paridhi (circumference) = 2πr aur kshetrafal = πr², jahan π ≈ 22/7 ya 3.14.
Trijya (radius) aadhi hoti hai vyaas (diameter) ki — vyaas 14 cm to trijya 7 cm, paridhi = 2 x 22/7 x 7 = 44 cm.
Aakaar badalne par kshetrafal same reh sakta hai — aayat ko kaat kar samantar chaturbhuj banane par kshetrafal nahi badalta — kat-pest me kul satah same rehti hai.
Ikai badalna zaroori hai: 1 m² = 10,000 cm²; kshetrafal hamesha varg ikai me aata hai.
Vrittakar path (ring) ka kshetrafal = bahari vritt - andaruni vritt ka kshetrafal — jaise park ke chaaron taraf path ka kshetrafal.
Aam galti: paridhi ke sutra me vyaas ki jagah trijya rakh dena bina 2 se guna kiye — 2πr me r trijya hai, vyaas nahi.
subject: Maths
title: Parimap aur Kshetrafal: Naye Aakaar
